mapper.sql: e.is_del = 0 AND e.entry_status IN (1, 3) AND e.entry_time <= #{end}

(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, #{end}) < 25 THEN '<25' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, #{end}) BETWEEN 25 AND 35 THEN '26-35' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, #{end}) BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45' ELSE '46+' END = #{ageBand})

(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 1 THEN '<1年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 3 THEN '1-3年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 5 THEN '3-5年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 10 THEN '5-10年' ELSE '10年以上' END = #{tenureBand})

CAST(COALESCE(e.highest_education, (SELECT CASE WHEN ee.education IN ('1','小学') THEN 1 WHEN ee.education IN ('2','初中') THEN 2 WHEN ee.education IN ('3','中专') THEN 3 WHEN ee.education IN ('4','中职') THEN 4 WHEN ee.education IN ('5','中技') THEN 5 WHEN ee.education IN ('6','高中') THEN 6 WHEN ee.education IN ('7','大专') THEN 7 WHEN ee.education IN ('8','本科') THEN 8 WHEN ee.education IN ('9','硕士') THEN 9 WHEN ee.education IN ('10','博士') THEN 10 WHEN ee.education IN ('11','博士后') THEN 11 WHEN ee.education IS NOT NULL THEN 12 ELSE NULL END FROM hrm_employee_education_experience ee WHERE ee.employee_id = e.employee_id AND ee.education IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(ee.sort, 999999), ee.education_id LIMIT 1)) AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.select: SELECT dept_id FROM hrm_dept WHERE parent_id = 0 AND (name = #{companyName} OR name = CONCAT(#{companyName}, '总部')) LIMIT 1

SELECT
CASE e.sex WHEN 1 THEN '男' WHEN 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS name,
AS name,
CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, #{end}) < 25 THEN '<25' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, #{end}) BETWEEN 25 AND 35 THEN '26-35' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, #{end}) BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45' ELSE '46+' END AS name,
CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 1 THEN '<1年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 3 THEN '1-3年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 5 THEN '3-5年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 10 THEN '5-10年' ELSE '10年以上' END AS name,
CASE e.employment_forms WHEN 1 THEN '正式' WHEN 2 THEN '非正式' ELSE '其他' END AS name,
IFNULL(d.name, '未分配部门') AS name,
COUNT(*) AS value FROM hrm_employee e LEFT JOIN hrm_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}
GROUP BY e.sex GROUP BY name GROUP BY name GROUP BY name GROUP BY e.employment_forms GROUP BY d.dept_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time), '${granule}') AS period, IFNULL(d.name, '未分配部门') AS deptName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hrm_employee_quit_info q JOIN hrm_employee e ON e.employee_id = q.employee_id AND e.is_del = 0 LEFT JOIN hrm_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN hrm_key_post_config k ON k.post_name = e.post WHERE COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND q.quit_type = #{quitType} GROUP BY period, d.dept_id ORDER BY period

SELECT
AS kx,
AS ks, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hrm_employee e LEFT JOIN hrm_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}
GROUP BY kx, ks

CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 1 THEN '<1年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 3 THEN '1-3年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 5 THEN '3-5年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, #{end}) < 10 THEN '5-10年' ELSE '10年以上' END

mapper.select:
SELECT
CASE q.quit_type WHEN 1 THEN '主动离职' WHEN 2 THEN '被动离职' ELSE '退休' END AS name,
q.quit_reason AS name,
CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time)) < 1 THEN '<1年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time)) < 3 THEN '1-3年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time)) < 5 THEN '3-5年' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time)) < 10 THEN '5-10年' ELSE '10年以上' END AS name,
CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time)) < 25 THEN '<25' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time)) BETWEEN 25 AND 35 THEN '26-35' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time)) BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45' ELSE '46+' END AS name,
AS name,
IFNULL(d.name, '未分配部门') AS name,
COUNT(*) AS value FROM hrm_employee_quit_info q JOIN hrm_employee e ON e.employee_id = q.employee_id AND e.is_del = 0 LEFT JOIN hrm_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE COALESCE(q.salary_settlement_time, q.plan_quit_time, q.apply_quit_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND q.quit_type = #{quitType}
GROUP BY q.quit_type GROUP BY q.quit_reason GROUP BY name GROUP BY name GROUP BY name GROUP BY d.dept_id
ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, CASE e.sex WHEN 1 THEN '男' WHEN 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS sex, CASE WHEN e.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.date_of_birth, NOW()) ELSE e.age END AS age, AS highestEducation, IFNULL(d.name, '') AS deptName, IFNULL(e.post, '') AS post, DATE_FORMAT(e.entry_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS entryTime, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.entry_time, NOW()) AS tenureYears, CASE e.entry_status WHEN 1 THEN '在职' WHEN 2 THEN '待入职' WHEN 3 THEN '待离职' ELSE '离职' END AS entryStatus, CASE e.employment_forms WHEN 1 THEN '正式' WHEN 2 THEN '非正式' ELSE '其他' END AS employmentForms FROM hrm_employee e LEFT JOIN hrm_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE e.is_del = 0 AND e.entry_status = #{entryStatus} AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND e.sex = #{sex} AND () = #{edu} ) t
AND t.age < 25 AND t.age BETWEEN 25 AND 35 AND t.age BETWEEN 36 AND 45 AND t.age >= 46 AND t.tenureYears < 1 AND t.tenureYears BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND t.tenureYears BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND t.tenureYears BETWEEN 5 AND 9 AND t.tenureYears >= 10
ORDER BY t.entryTime DESC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.expected_pay_salary), 0) AS expectedPay, IFNULL(SUM(r.real_pay_salary), 0) AS realPay, IFNULL(SUM(r.corporate_insurance_amount + r.corporate_provident_fund_amount), 0) AS corpSocialFund, IFNULL(SUM(r.corporate_insurance_amount), 0) AS corpInsurance, IFNULL(SUM(r.corporate_provident_fund_amount), 0) AS corpFund, IFNULL(SUM(r.personal_tax), 0) AS personalTax, IFNULL(AVG(r.num), 0) AS avgHeadcount, COUNT(*) AS monthCount FROM hrm_salary_month_record r WHERE (r.year > #{startYear} OR (r.year = #{startYear} AND r.month >= #{startMonth})) AND (r.year < #{endYear} OR (r.year = #{endYear} AND r.month <= #{endMonth})) AND (r.check_status IS NULL OR r.check_status NOT IN (2, 4, 5, 8))

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(b.bonus), 0) AS bonus FROM hrm_bonus b WHERE (b.year > #{startYear} OR (b.year = #{startYear} AND b.month >= #{startMonth})) AND (b.year < #{endYear} OR (b.year = #{endYear} AND b.month <= #{endMonth}))

SELECT
CONCAT(r.year, '年') AS period CONCAT(r.year, '-', LPAD(r.month, 2, '0')) AS period
, SUM(r.expected_pay_salary) AS expectedPay , SUM(r.real_pay_salary) AS realPay , SUM(r.corporate_insurance_amount + r.corporate_provident_fund_amount) AS corpSocialFund , SUM(r.personal_tax) AS personalTax , AVG(r.num) AS avgHeadcount FROM hrm_salary_month_record r WHERE (r.year > #{startYear} OR (r.year = #{startYear} AND r.month >= #{startMonth})) AND (r.year < #{endYear} OR (r.year = #{endYear} AND r.month <= #{endMonth})) AND (r.check_status IS NULL OR r.check_status NOT IN (2, 4, 5, 8)) GROUP BY
r.year r.year, r.month
ORDER BY period

SELECT
CONCAT(r.year, '年') AS period CONCAT(r.year, '-', LPAD(r.month, 2, '0')) AS period
, SUM(r.corporate_insurance_amount) AS corpInsurance , SUM(r.corporate_provident_fund_amount) AS corpFund , SUM(r.personal_insurance_amount) AS personalInsurance , SUM(r.personal_provident_fund_amount) AS personalFund FROM hrm_salary_month_record r WHERE (r.year > #{startYear} OR (r.year = #{startYear} AND r.month >= #{startMonth})) AND (r.year < #{endYear} OR (r.year = #{endYear} AND r.month <= #{endMonth})) AND (r.check_status IS NULL OR r.check_status NOT IN (2, 4, 5, 8)) GROUP BY
r.year r.year, r.month
ORDER BY period

SELECT IFNULL(d.name, '未分配部门') AS deptName, SUM(CASE WHEN ov.code = 210101 THEN CAST(NULLIF(ov.value, '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) ELSE 0 END) AS expectedPay, SUM(CASE WHEN ov.code = 240101 THEN CAST(NULLIF(ov.value, '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) ELSE 0 END) AS realPay, SUM(CASE WHEN ov.code = 41001 THEN CAST(NULLIF(ov.value, '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) ELSE 0 END) AS bonus FROM hrm_salary_month_emp_record er JOIN hrm_salary_month_option_value ov ON ov.s_emp_record_id = er.s_emp_record_id JOIN hrm_employee e ON e.employee_id = er.employee_id AND e.is_del = 0 LEFT JOIN hrm_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE (er.year > #{startYear} OR (er.year = #{startYear} AND er.month >= #{startMonth})) AND (er.year < #{endYear} OR (er.year = #{endYear} AND er.month <= #{endMonth}))
GROUP BY d.dept_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ov.code IN (210101, 240101, 41001) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY deptName

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, IFNULL(d.name, '未分配部门') AS deptName, IFNULL(e.post, '') AS post, MAX(er.actual_work_day) AS actualWorkDay, MAX(CASE WHEN ov.code = 210101 THEN CAST(NULLIF(ov.value, '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END) AS expectedPay, MAX(CASE WHEN ov.code = 240101 THEN CAST(NULLIF(ov.value, '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END) AS realPay, MAX(CASE WHEN ov.code = 230101 THEN CAST(NULLIF(ov.value, '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END) AS personalTax, MAX(CASE WHEN ov.code = 41001 THEN CAST(NULLIF(ov.value, '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END) AS bonus FROM hrm_salary_month_emp_record er JOIN hrm_salary_month_option_value ov ON ov.s_emp_record_id = er.s_emp_record_id JOIN hrm_employee e ON e.employee_id = er.employee_id AND e.is_del = 0 LEFT JOIN hrm_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE er.year = #{year} AND er.month = #{month} AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}
GROUP BY er.s_emp_record_id, e.employee_id, e.employee_name, d.name, e.post ) t ORDER BY t.expectedPay DESC

SELECT
CONCAT(i.stat_year, '年') AS period CONCAT(i.stat_year, '-', LPAD(i.stat_month, 2, '0')) AS period
, SUM(IFNULL(i.target_value, 0)) AS targetValue , SUM(IFNULL(i.actual_value, 0)) AS actualValue FROM hrm_performance_indicator i WHERE i.indicator_type = #{indicatorType} AND (i.stat_year > #{startYear} OR (i.stat_year = #{startYear} AND i.stat_month >= #{startMonth})) AND (i.stat_year < #{endYear} OR (i.stat_year = #{endYear} AND i.stat_month <= #{endMonth})) AND i.dept_id = #{deptId} AND i.dept_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT dept_id FROM hrm_dept WHERE dept_id = #{rootDeptId} UNION ALL SELECT d2.dept_id FROM hrm_dept d2 JOIN dept_tree dt ON d2.parent_id = dt.dept_id ) SELECT dept_id FROM dept_tree ) GROUP BY
i.stat_year i.stat_year, i.stat_month
ORDER BY period

SELECT i.indicator_type AS indicatorType, SUM(IFNULL(i.target_value, 0)) AS targetValue, SUM(IFNULL(i.actual_value, 0)) AS actualValue, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM hrm_performance_indicator i WHERE (i.stat_year > #{startYear} OR (i.stat_year = #{startYear} AND i.stat_month >= #{startMonth})) AND (i.stat_year < #{endYear} OR (i.stat_year = #{endYear} AND i.stat_month <= #{endMonth})) AND i.dept_id = #{deptId} AND i.dept_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT dept_id FROM hrm_dept WHERE dept_id = #{rootDeptId} UNION ALL SELECT d2.dept_id FROM hrm_dept d2 JOIN dept_tree dt ON d2.parent_id = dt.dept_id ) SELECT dept_id FROM dept_tree ) GROUP BY i.indicator_type ORDER BY i.indicator_type
